content: FastAPI official docs now recommend pwdlib[argon2] (not passlib) for password hashing. Argon2id is the recommended algorithm. passlib 1.7.4 (released 2020) is effectively unmaintained — no Python 3.13 support. The FastAPI team updated their OAuth2/JWT tutorial to use pwdlib. bcrypt remains widely used but has a 72-byte password limit. argon2-cffi 25.1.0 (June 2025) is actively maintained and can be used directly without passlib wrapper. pwdlib 0.3.0 (Oct 2025) wraps argon2-cffi or bcrypt with a simple PasswordHash.recommended() API.
